initialization: Before each heartbeat and when the Chief starts, scan .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md. For every unregistered skill, add a record with its directory name, the current ISO 8601 timestamp as trackingBaseline, null lastUserUse and lastReminder values, and one concrete example request. At the 13:00 heartbeat, remind about at most one skill unused for 72 hours and only once per unused stretch. The example may come from the skill; otherwise use 'Use $<skill-name> to help me.'
